sources.name: 2024 .com agreement
sources.supports: Appendix 7 sections 3.1.3, 3.1.6, 3.3.2: 45-day registry accounting, 30-day redemption after deletion, final five-day pending delete. Ordinary .com scope. Section 8.2 contains o.com exceptions.

sources.name: Current ERRP
sources.supports: Updated February 2024; mandatory August 2025. Sections 2.2, 3 and 4: deletion subject to applicable rules, DNS interruption renewal protections, nonsponsored gTLD 30-day redemption with add-grace exception, deleting registrar recovery and fee disclosure.

sources.name: ICANN EPP guide
sources.supports: pendingDelete can coexist with redemptionPeriod or pendingRestore. Combined codes follow redemption/restoration description. Registry policy governs re-registration.

sources.name: ICANN expiration FAQ
sources.supports: Registrant recovery and five-day pending delete, and first-come registration after release.

sources.name: GoDaddy timeline
sources.supports: Standard process: parking +5 and auction +26, bid/purchase conditions, ccTLD exceptions, no registry release timing advice.

sources.name: Dynadot backorder FAQ
sources.supports: Successful catch plus multiple backorders causes public auction. Corrects original claim that competing services each catch and trigger private auction.
